clue.text: That moralising upset numbers in old-fashioned school lessons

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disordered, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A preachy attitude spoiled the arithmetic classes in a traditional school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' scrambles the fourteen letters of THAT MORALISING. Antilogarithms were looked up in printed tables, which pupils used before calculators.
explanation.definitionFit: Antilogs were values read from log tables, a staple of maths classes before electronic calculators made them obsolete.

clue.text: Feel boas and asps get nasty in old stories

indicators.note: to get nasty is to turn ugly, so the letters of the snake-filled words are turned into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Snakes of the feather-boa and asp kinds turn vicious in ancient tales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get nasty' rearranges FEEL BOAS plus ASPS; 'and' simply joins the two pieces of fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The fables credited to Aesop are ancient Greek moral tales, many featuring talking animals such as snakes.

clue.text: 'Card' as someone who might pull your leg?

definitions.meaning: to card wool is to comb it out, which is also called teasing it

definitions.text: someone who might pull your leg
definitions.meaning: a person who ... you, joking at your expense

explanation.surface: Is a 'card', a joker, the sort of person who kids you?
explanation.definitionFit: Carding and teasing are both ways of combing fibres, and a tease is a person who mocks playfully.

clue.text: Without hesitation, fate has sealed ex-president as initiator of hatred

indicators.note: something that has sealed other letters encloses them, so these pieces go inside the word for fate

parts.note: one's lot is one's fate
Ike was the nickname of US president Dwight Eisenhower

indicators.note: the initiator is what starts something, so take the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Destiny swiftly doomed a former president who became a source of hatred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has sealed' is the container signal: fate wraps around the president and the rest. Ike, Eisenhower's nickname, is the setter's favourite ex-president.
explanation.definitionFit: To do something like a shot is an idiom for doing it instantly and eagerly, with no pause.

clue.text: Smile, looking embarrassed, showing up tooth

parts.note: a grin is a broad smile

indicators.note: in a down entry, showing up means appearing upwards, so the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: someone embarrassed goes red

explanation.surface: A sheepish smile reveals a tooth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing up' only works as a reversal because this is a down entry, read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A grinder is an informal name for a molar, one of the back teeth that crush food.

clue.text: Partygoer stealing silver is one causing much damage

indicators.note: a thief stealing something takes it in, so the word for partygoer swallows the symbol

parts.note: a raver is someone who goes to raves or wild parties
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A party animal pockets the silverware and wrecks the place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stealing' signals a container: the partygoer takes the silver into himself, as a thief would.
explanation.definitionFit: To ravage is to devastate, so a ravager is a destroyer who lays waste to things.

clue.text: Big person to get screwed up, we hear?

indicators.note: we hear marks a word said out loud, matching another spelt differently

parts.note: a screw turned up is tightened, so the phrase means tighten

explanation.surface: Does a giant become tense and anxious, apparently?
explanation.walkthrough: TIGHTEN, said out loud, sounds like TITAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Titans were giant Greek gods, so the word now means any person of great size or stature.

clue.text: Head of state's icon, working with charm

indicators.note: letters working are set in motion and moved about, so the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A king's image works alongside his personal magnetism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges ICON plus CHARM; 'with' joins them. The definition is possessive, matching an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Monarchic describes what belongs to a king or queen, the sovereign who heads the state.

clue.text: Quiet refuge for animals and fish

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
Noah's ark sheltered the animals from the Flood

explanation.surface: A peaceful animal sanctuary also has fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharks are cartilaginous predatory fishes of the sea.

clue.text: Attractive home — paying a call is not permitted

parts.note: to be in is to be at home

indicators.note: what is not permitted is kept out, so the word is removed from the visiting word

parts.note: visiting means paying a call on someone

explanation.surface: A lovely house, but visitors are banned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not permitted' removes the clue word 'is' itself from the synonym of 'paying a call', so the surface's ban on visits is the mechanism.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inviting is tempting and appealing, drawing a person towards it.

clue.text: Hippies quietly elope, running south of river?

indicators.note: in a down entry, south of means placed below, so these letters come after the river

parts.note: in crosswords a flower is something that flows, a river
p is piano, the musical direction for quietly

indicators.note: running means set in motion, so the letters of the word are mixed up

explanation.surface: Free-spirited lovers quietly run off to marry, down by the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running' scrambles 'elope'; 'south of' places the rest below the river in this down entry. A flower, in crosswords, is something that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: Flower people were the 1960s counterculture, the flower-power generation who preached peace and love.

clue.text: Like some bought items with quiet salesman to help

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a rep is a sales representative
aid means help

explanation.surface: Shopping paid for in advance, with a quiet salesman lending a hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods already paid for before delivery are described as prepaid, as some purchases are.

clue.text: Friendly Queen knocking one out as usual

indicators.note: one piece knocking another out takes its place, so the Queen's letters replace the numeral
out completes the phrase knocking out, the removal of the numeral to make room

parts.note: genial means friendly
the Roman numeral I is one
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: An amiable monarch delivers a knockout as she customarily does.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocking out' swaps the I in GENIAL for ER; 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: General means prevailing or common, true in most cases, as the customary state of things is.

clue.text: Some relief if there's a musical interval

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A musician finds comfort in a pleasing harmony.
explanation.definitionFit: A fifth is the gap of five scale degrees between two notes, such as C up to G.

clue.text: Father on time to meet party men in entrance to house?

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
a do is a party
OR is other ranks, soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: A priest arrives on time to greet the guests at the party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to meet' and 'in' are links. The question mark admits a house has other entrances.
explanation.definitionFit: The front door is the main way into a home, facing the street.

clue.text: Artist with Welsh name who transformed old entertainment

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
Rees is a common Welsh name

indicators.note: transformed means changed in form, so the letters of the little word are reordered

explanation.surface: A painter from Wales who changed his style and became famous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transformed' rearranges WHO into HOW.
explanation.definitionFit: A raree-show was a peep show carried in a box by travelling showmen, a street amusement of earlier centuries.

clue.text: Very gradually start off to conceal excavation

indicators.note: to conceal something is to hide it inside, so the shortened word holds the excavation
with its start off, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: gently can mean gradually, as with a gently sloping hill
a mine is an excavation

explanation.surface: Instructions to begin slowly while hiding a dig.
explanation.walkthrough: 'start off' removes the first letter, leaving ENTLY; 'to conceal' then puts the excavation inside it, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminently is an intensifier meaning highly or extremely, as in eminently sensible.

clue.text: Mistake with awkward bust, female finally squeezing into these?

parts.note: a boob is a blunder

indicators.note: a letter squeezing into a word goes inside it
something awkward is twisted out of shape, so these letters are rearranged
finally picks out the last letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A blunder with an ill-fitting bust leads a woman to squeeze into strapless tops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkward' turns BUST into TUBS, and 'squeezing into' puts E, the last of 'female', inside it. 'these' points back to the whole picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Boob tubes are strapless elastic tops that a wearer squeezes into, matching the scene described.

clue.text: Before Caesar's last day something risky happens

indicators.note: Before says the risky word comes first, ahead of Caesar's day

parts.note: a bet is a gamble, a risk
Julius Caesar was murdered on the Ides of March

explanation.surface: Something dangerous occurs just ahead of the day Caesar was killed.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ides were the middle day of a Roman month; Caesar died on the Ides of March, 44 BC.
explanation.definitionFit: Betide is an old verb meaning to happen or befall, as in woe betide you.

clue.text: Musical part that you get with Prokofiev but not with Mendelssohn

definitions.text: Musical part that you get with Prokofiev but not with Mendelssohn

parts.words: Musical part that you get with Prokofiev but not with Mendelssohn
parts.note: the composer surname Prokofiev contains a second letter O, whereas Mendelssohn holds only one

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a piece of music found in one Russian composer's work but not in a German's.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as SECOND O: Prokofiev's name has two Os, Mendelssohn's only one.
explanation.definitionFit: Secondo is the lower part in a piano duet, played by the second pianist, in Italian terms.

clue.text: Old police force, given its situation, about to suffer

parts.note: in gives a thing's situation, its location

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the police force's letters are read backwards

parts.note: the RUC was the Royal Ulster Constabulary, Northern Ireland's police until 2001

explanation.surface: A disbanded police force, in its circumstances, is about to suffer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the Royal Ulster Constabulary's initials round; 'given its situation' is a roundabout way of saying in. 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To incur a loss or penalty is to bring it upon oneself and undergo it.

clue.text: Yesterday's religious leaflet or a passage from it?

parts.note: ex means former, belonging to yesterday
a tract is a short religious pamphlet

explanation.surface: An outdated evangelical pamphlet, or a quotation taken from it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' is a link; 'it' points back to the leaflet, so the definition reads naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: An extract is a short section quoted from a longer text.

clue.text: A seat occupied by Liberal — is this a record?

indicators.note: a seat occupied by someone holds them, so the letter goes inside the phrase a seat

parts.note: bum is slang for the backside, the seat

explanation.surface: A Liberal sits in a seat; could this be a record?
explanation.walkthrough: 'occupied by' puts L inside A BUM; 'is this a' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: An album is a long-playing record, a collection of tracks released together.

clue.text: Energy-packed tea with cooked item — it's not expensive

indicators.note: a word packed with a letter has it stuffed inside

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
E is the physics symbol for energy
a pie is a baked dish

explanation.surface: A cuppa bursting with energy and a hot snack makes a cheap meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'packed' is a container signal: the tea is packed with energy, giving CHEA. Cha is old British slang for tea.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheapie is an informal word for a low-cost item, something bought for little money.

clue.text: Greek philosopher half ignored old Roman god

indicators.note: with half ignored, only the first four of the philosopher's eight letters are kept

parts.note: Plutarch was a Greek philosopher and biographer

explanation.surface: A Greek thinker half forgotten becomes an ancient Roman deity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half ignored' cuts PLUTARCH to PLUT; 'Plato' is the tempting philosopher, but no change of his name fits.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluto was the Roman ruler of the underworld, equivalent to the Greek Hades.

clue.text: I need job done …

indicators.note: done can mean worked over or done in, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A candidate states he needs work finished, leading into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'done' rearranges I NEED JOB. The ellipsis links to the next clue: he needed the presidency to beat his predecessor.
explanation.definitionFit: Biden needed the presidency, the job, to defeat Trump, so the words fit him speaking.

clue.text: … to eclipse my predecessor

definitions.meaning: read on from the previous clue, the speaker is Biden

explanation.surface: Biden aims to outshine the president before him.
explanation.definitionFit: To trump is to beat by playing a higher card, and Donald Trump preceded Biden in the White House.

clue.text: Financial document provided by three characters joined in impecuniousness

definitions.text: Financial document provided by three characters joined in impecuniousness

parts.words: Financial document provided by three characters joined in impecuniousness
parts.note: a broke person may hand over an IOU, three letters joined, as a written pledge to pay later

explanation.surface: A paper given by someone short of cash, consisting of three letters.
explanation.walkthrough: The three characters are I, O, U: an IOU is the classic such pledge written by someone with no money.
explanation.definitionFit: A promissory note is a written promise to pay a sum, of which an IOU is the informal form.
